From the Old Garden No. II

description: Swirling, abstract flowers in shades of bright purple, yellow, and blue fill the composition. Small blue flowers dot the canvas, framing a central abstract form that resembles a large purple flower filled with holes. These objects sit against a pale blue background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
